title: Meta’s new commercial terms will allow the scraping of news sites: experts
summary: Meta is updating its commercial terms to explicitly permit scraping of news content from publishers' websites, a move that legal experts say could fundamentally alter the relationship between big tech platforms and news media. The new terms appear designed to support AI training on news content while potentially sidestepping existing licensing agreements with publishers.
problem_solved: Addresses Meta's legal framework for accessing and using news content for AI training purposes without compensating publishers.
why_valuable: This represents a pivotal shift in big tech's approach to news content rights, potentially affecting how journalism is monetized in the AI era.
